name: Shadows in Noise
source: For fans of Twilight Princess who always thought there was quite a bit of erotic tension between Link and Midna, in this doujin (fan) game you play the role of Link as he brushes up on the art of seduction. [From [url=http://games.renpy.org/game/shadowsinnoise.shtml]Ren'Py Games List[/url]]
translation:
如果你是《塞尔达传说 黄昏公主》的玩家，又总觉得林克和米多娜之间有着强烈的性张力，那么这部同人游戏就是为你准备的。你将扮演林克，磨练自己的调情本领。

[摘自[url=http://games.renpy.org/game/shadowsinnoise.shtml]Ren’Py游戏目录[/url]]
